frame: origin at each sleeve center, +Y along transverse shaft, +X forward, +Z upward; fixed parts never inherit shaft phase

running_gap.interpretation: Nominal sleeve-to-lining radial display clearance, not an established bearing fit.

lining_stock.interpretation: Poured babbitt radial thickness; source identifies material but gives no thickness.

end_gap.interpretation: Fixed liner/casting ends stop this far short of sleeve barrel ends.

split_gap.interpretation: Half of the display gap at the cap/bracket split; not a manufacturing tolerance.

inner_cast_radius.interpretation: Approximate casting radial envelope around the inside sleeve.

outer_cast_radius.interpretation: Approximate casting radial envelope around the outside sleeve.

web_stock.interpretation: Unmeasured axial web thickness of bracket I profile.

bracket_height.interpretation: Unmeasured vertical extent of bracket web/foot; plan section does not constrain height.

rear_stem_height.interpretation: Unmeasured vertical extent of outer bracket rear stem.

ear_radius.interpretation: Four cap stud bosses; rounded casting approximations from HB20.

ear_x_extent.interpretation: Cap and bracket stud boss depths on either side of split.

stud_diameter.interpretation: Nominal 3/4 inch stud body from SNL42; threads not yet modeled.

stud_hole_gap.interpretation: Radial display allowance in unthreaded cap/bracket pilot bores.

stud_y_inset.interpretation: Stud axes inset from casting axial ends.

cup_length.interpretation: Common M295 cover suggests common oil-cup opening across inside/outside caps.

cup_width.interpretation: Approximate oil cup axial width from section and HB20.

cup_stock.interpretation: Unmeasured oil cup wall and bottom stock.

lid_overhang.interpretation: Approximate cover lip beyond cup. Cap is cut to a flat seat under this footprint, keeping the closed common lid clear of the curved casting.

lid_gap.interpretation: Display clearance between closed lid and cup lip.

inner_cup_front.interpretation: Forward reach approximated from Plate22 y778.

outer_cup_front.interpretation: Forward reach approximated from Plate22 y742.

conditional_image_picks.interpretation: Plate22 section read as horizontal axial section: image up is aft; dimensions share the four-inch hub calibration. Foot heights and stud positions are independently assumed.
